estimator_analysis.confirmed_method: count_tokens uses len(text) // 3 for strings, recursively sums list items and dict values, and does not count dict keys or JSON punctuation.
estimator_analysis.finding: The estimator's treatment of mixed Chinese/English text and omission of schema object keys are confirmed weaknesses. The archived request body is absent, so the contribution of each weakness, provider-side prompt additions, and tokenizer-specific differences cannot be quantified separately.
estimator_analysis.serialized_size_is_not_token_count: The prior offline reconstruction measured 12807 serialized characters and 19315 UTF-8 bytes under a different binding/runtime. Those byte counts establish request-shape scale only; they are not provider token counts and are not historical request evidence.
